page_title: GET 0-0 SEV | Getafe v Sevilla 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+5' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) replacing Dodi Lukebakio.
90+5' Here is a change. Isaac Romero is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
90+4' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) for Juanmi.
90+1' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' PENALTY APPEAL by Getafe, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
87' David Soria (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
82' David Soria (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' A substitution has been made. Saul Niguez is replaced by Akor Adams (Sevilla).
78' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Sola (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Christantus Uche can be given a rest.
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Carles Perez is replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
76' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) replaces Ruben Vargas.
76' Today's match ends for Adria Pedrosa who will be replaced by Kike Salas (Sevilla).
72' Christantus Uche (Getafe) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
68' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
67' A cross from a corner kick by Getafe is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
65' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo De Burgos no option but to blow his whistle.
62' 39:61 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
58' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
56' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) for a tough tackle.
55' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
54' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) sees a yellow card from Ricardo De Burgos after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ricardo De Burgos ignores the protests.
48' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has made a change at the break. Borja Mayoral (Getafe) has come on in place of Coba Gomez da Costa.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
44' What a big chance! Juanmi (Getafe) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
41' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
39' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day.
38' Ricardo De Burgos shows the yellow card to Djene (Getafe) for a heavy challenge.
37' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
35' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
33' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Carles Perez (Getafe), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
29' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
27' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The foul by Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo De Burgos.
25' Getafe fail to score from a corner as Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.
25' Juanmi (Getafe) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
24' A yellow card for a tackle by Saul Niguez (Sevilla). Ricardo De Burgos doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
23' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
22' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
21' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
19' Ricardo De Burgos rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
19' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
17' None of the Getafe players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
13' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
9' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
8' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) commits a rough foul. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and makes a call.
6' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
5' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
5' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Saul Niguez (Sevilla) inside the box.
3' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle after Carles Perez (Getafe) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos will officiate today.
